get.description:
The Zywave API search is implemented using [OData Version 4.0.1](https://www.odata.org/documentation/). Not all OData operations are available for the Zywave API platform at this time. Not all properties are filterable or sortable.
 The following properties that can be used when filtering and ordering the response.
  *  id
  *  accountId
  *  firstName
  *  lastName
  *  isPrimaryContact
  *  isActive

 The following OData filter operations are supported by the Zywave API; each is accompanied by an example request.
 
 | Operation | Example Request | Returns |
 | ------- | -------- | -------- |
 | endswith   | endswith(lastName,'tact')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name ends with 'tact'    |
 | startswith   | startswith(lastName,'Cont')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name starts with 'Cont'    |
 | contains   | contains(lastName,'tact')    | Returns all account contacts where the name contains 'tact'    |
 | Equals   | accountId eq 2726742    | Returns all account contacts for the Zywave account with this unique id    |
 | Not Equals   | isActive ne false    | Returns all account contacts that are active    |
 | In   | lastName in ('Cont', 'act')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name is 'Cont' or 'act'    |
 | Not   | not startswith(lastName, 'Cont')    | Returns all account contacts where the last name does not start with 'Cont'    |
      
 The Zywave API also supports the And operation which will allow for multiple search criteria to be applied to a single request. For example, the following filter will return all active account contacts for the given account;
      
      
   *accountId eq 726742 and isActive ne false*
     
         
 The orderby operation also supports multiple levels of ordering. For example, to order the results by accountId then lastName the following can be used;
     
 
   *accountId asc, lastName asc*

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: The search criteria for the request. To view a list of supported search operations and the properties which can be searched see the documentation above.

parameters.name: $orderBy
parameters.description: Defines the order in which the results are returned. To view a list of properties that can be used in ordering see the documentation above.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: The number of total records to skip before displaying the first result. For example, if there are 10 total records and $skip is set to 5 the first record shown in the response will be the 6th record returned. In order to avoid an error please ensure that the $skip is dividable by the $top.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The total number of records returned in the response. In order to avoid an error please ensure that the $skip is dividable by the $top.

get.summary: Search for business and personal industries.
get.description:
The Zywave API search is implemented using [OData Version 4.0.1](https://www.odata.org/documentation/). Not all OData operations are available for the Zywave API platform at this time. Not all properties are filterable or sortable.
 The following properties can be used when filtering and ordering the response.
  *  id
  *  name
  *  naicsCode

 The following OData filter operations are supported by the Zywave API; each is accompanied by an example request.
 
 | Operation | Example Request | Returns |
 | ------- | -------- | -------- |
 | startswith   | startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all industries where the name starts with 'Zyw'    |
 | endswith | endswith(Name,'wave') | Returns all industries where the name ends with 'wave' |
 | contains   | contains(Name,'wave')    | Returns all industries where the name contains 'wave'    |
 | Equals   | Name eq 'Zywave'    | Returns all industries named Zywave    |
 | Not Equals   | Name ne 'Zywave'    | Returns all industries not named Zywave    |
 | Greater Than   | naicsCode gt 22      | Returns all industries with a nacisCode greater than 22    |
 | Greater Than or equal   | naicsCode ge 22    | Returns all industries with a nacisCode greater than or equal to 22    |
 | Less Than   | naicsCode lt 22       | Returns all industries with a nacisCode less than or equal to 22    |
 | Less Than or equal     | naicsCode le 22       | Returns all industries with a nacisCode less than or equal to 22    |
 | In   | Name in ('Zyw', 'ave')    | Returns all industries with the names 'Zyw' or 'ave'.    |
 | Not   | not startswith(Name,'Zyw')    | Returns all industries with a name that doesn't start with ‘Zyw’    |
 The Zywave API also supports the And operation which will allow for multiple search criteria to be applied to a single request. For example, the following filter will return all industries with a name that incldes ‘I’ and a naicsCode greater than 22
 
   *Contains(Name, 'I') and naicsCode gt 22*
 
 The orderby operation also supports multiple levels of ordering. For example, to order the results by name and then by naicsCode, the following can be used;
 

   *Name asc, naicsCode desc*

sicCode.description: The standard industry classification code for a business account. This code is used to classify the industry area of a business.

naicsCodes.description: A list of North American Classification Systems codes applicable to a business account. This code is used to classify a business for the purposes of collecting, analyzing and publishing data related to the US business economy. The code must be a 2- to 6-digit code. If a NAICS code isn't applicable to the most recent set of codes, you may optionally indicate the year it was applicable followed by a "|" before the standard 2- to 6-digit code. For example, 2012|212234 can be sent to represent the industry "Copper Ore and Nickel Ore Mining", although this code is not applicable to the 2017 set. The year must be a valid NAICS versioning year (e.g. 1997, or 2002, or 2007, etc.). For a list of all standardized NAICS codes, see https://www.census.gov/eos/www/naics/.

classification.description: Specifies whether the account is a business account or personal account.

relationships.description: A list of relationships a broker has with a client distinguishing whether the account is a current client or prospect for both the employee benefits and property and casualty units within the broker.

clientSize.description: Specifies a client size range for business accounts.

isActive.description: Determines whether the account is active throughout the Zywave product suite. If this is set to false the contacts for the account will also be marked as inactive and the account will not appear throughout the Zywave product suite. If not sent in the request isActive will be set to true.
